item.title: Replying to Alon it’s always funny how people that say this never actually set out the numbers
item.description:
Replying to Alon it’s always funny how people that say this never actually set out the numbers. China has, at most, 500 actually up-and-running data centres, most of which are not hyperscale data centres like in the United States, whereas the United States has upwards of 5,500. The scale is astronomical. China is not competing with us on data centres but they are beating us at AI because one is treating it like a vanity project for oligarchs to get wealthier and one is treating it like a development in software

item.description:
To be clear: their business model is not feasible everyone knows, but the reality that will force that truth to match the markets is when there is a marketable alternative - and that is precisely what Chinese technology presents. It is not a matter of Chinese technology making the business model unfeasible. It is a matter of proving that it is unfeasible.

item.title: A good baseline for politics might be that if the IDF is doing it, maybe you shun it
item.description:
A good baseline for politics might be that if the IDF is doing it, maybe you shun it. This isn’t universal and of course the classic thing goes, “My enemy breathes too.” But if they’re saying that veterans are worth celebrating, consider why they think they’re worth celebrating. Consider what actual labour would go into changing both the actually existing social construction of that identity that they find worth celebrating and... What do we want to reclaim from it?

item.title: Why are you thanking them for their service if you think they are victims of the system they served?
item.description:
Why are you thanking them for their service if you think they are victims of the system they served? Because you don’t largely that is an excuse to whitewash the crimes that the American military instrumentalised them to commit and the role they had in re-creating that system. We don’t say this about any other terror org from the IDF to RSF, so don’t say it about the DOD.
